<script is:inline>
  // Remembers a reader's area, followed areas, and saved places on this device until sign in is connected.
  (function () {
    function g(k, d) { try { var v = localStorage.getItem(k); return v ? JSON.parse(v) : d; } catch (e) { return d; } }
    function s(k, v) { try { localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); } catch (e) {} }
    var TL = window.TL = {
      get: g, set: s,
      area: function () { return g('tl_area', ''); }, setArea: function (a) { s('tl_area', a); },
      follows: function () { return g('tl_follows', []); }, setFollows: function (a) { s('tl_follows', a); },
      saved: function () { return g('tl_saved', []); },
      toggleSaved: function (slug) { var a = g('tl_saved', []), i = a.indexOf(slug); if (i > -1) a.splice(i, 1); else a.push(slug); s('tl_saved', a); return i < 0; }
    };
    function paint() {
      var saved = TL.saved();
      document.querySelectorAll('.save').forEach(function (b) {
        var on = saved.indexOf(b.dataset.slug) > -1;
        b.classList.toggle('on', on); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
        b.setAttribute('aria-label', (on ? 'Remove ' : 'Save ') + (b.dataset.name || 'place') + (on ? ' from saved' : ''));
      });
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.save'); if (!b) return;
      e.preventDefault(); TL.toggleSaved(b.dataset.slug); paint(); document.dispatchEvent(new Event('tl:saved'));
    });
    document.addEventListener('tl:repaint', paint); paint();
  })();
</script>
